vscode.org.priority.up: Emacs has no key of its own for it in an Org file: S-<up> on a headline (org.shift.up) raises the priority.
vscode.org.priority.down: Emacs has no key of its own for it in an Org file: S-<down> on a headline (org.shift.down) lowers the priority.
vscode.org.timestamp.up: Emacs has no key of its own for it: S-<up> on a timestamp (org.shift.up) changes it.
vscode.org.timestamp.down: Emacs has no key of its own for it: S-<down> on a timestamp (org.shift.down) changes it.
vscode.org.table.insert.row.below: Emacs has no key for it: org-table-insert-row inserts below with a prefix argument.
